title: combo box
name: Combo box
rule: When text input must be paired with a list of choices, use a combo box.
pass_when: Type-plus-list task uses a combo box (text field + choice list).
fail_when: Type-plus-list is split into disconnected text and list, or list-only when typing is required.
overview: Pair typing with a choice list via a combo box when both are required.
apply_when: Tasks need both free typing and picking from a list.
not_when: List-only or type-only tasks that do not need both modes.
agent_hint: Use a combo box when the task needs typing plus a choice list.
description: When text input must be paired with a list of choices, use a combo box — a text field plus choice list — rather than disconnected controls. Pass when the type-plus-list task uses that pattern; fail when typing and list are split with no combo, or a list-only control is used when typing is required. Match the control to the dual need, not to habit.
